messages:
Asha (People Ops): Dropping a follow-up here from today's all-hands  feel free to ask clarifying Qs about travel, hubs, offsite lodging formats, and expense rules.
Liam P.: Quick one  I'm planning to bring my partner to a 4-day offsite (we'd stay in the same AirBnB). Is partner lodging reimbursable?
Asha (People Ops): Short answer: partner/companion costs are generally not covered unless there's a documented business need (e.g., caregiver required for the employee to travel). If you think there's an exception, include a one-paragraph justification in the offsite request and we'll route to Finance + Legal.
Nora G.: Can teams book a shared house or boutique rental instead of a hotel to keep costs down and do team activities? Any AV/security concerns?
Asha (People Ops): Yes, rentals are allowed with manager pre-approval. Requirements: 1) itemized receipt/invoice in Concur, 2) host cancellation/refund policy attached, 3) for sites with shared common areas, add a safety plan (who's onsite contact). Facilities will help with any badge/door access needs.
Diego (Facilities): If you're using an office hub as a base for an offsite day, please add the event to the hub calendar and select the "Offsite - Team" option so we can unlock rooms and prep AV. For non-office venues, provide a day-of contact and emergency number.
Liam P.: Great. What's the rule on booking airfare  cheapest reasonable vs. direct flights?
Finance Bot: Travel policy: book economy or basic economy unless manager approves premium for medical/other documented reasons. If premium fare is cheaper than multiple legs with long layovers, include screenshot showing cost comparison. Use corporate travel portal (Concur/TravelCorp) to book.
Nora G.: Are we able to request an advance for larger upfront costs (house rental, deposit)?
Asha (People Ops): We can request a vendor invoice/direct bill via Finance for venue deposits. For card advances, Finance reviews on a case-by-case basis  ping me and I'll open the request.
Liam P.: Visa letters/timing for international offsites?
Marta (Legal): For visa invite letters, request at least 6 weeks out (8 preferred) with attendee list + passport name. We can provide letters but applicants must follow consulate rules. Notice: Legal will not guarantee visa approval.
Nora G.: Childcare reimbursement? A few teammates asked about on-site childcare costs while traveling.
Asha (People Ops): We reimburse reasonable childcare incurred because of company travel; attach receipt and a short note in Concur. If it's a longer program (week+), ask for prior approval so we can confirm budget.
Liam P.: One last: any special COVID/health guidance for offsite venues?
Asha (People Ops): No company vaccine mandate; follow local rules. For higher-risk settings, include mitigation steps in the form (ventilation, masks available, outdoor options).
Asha (People Ops): Helpful links: Offsite request & policy: https://redwood.internal/policies/offsites | Office hub booking: https://redwood.internal/hubs | Travel policy summary: https://redwood.internal/policies/travel
Nora G.: Thanks  I'll draft the form and tag Asha for pre-review.
Asha (People Ops): Happy to review!
